title: Story premise ENT079: The Pocket-Sized Home
summary: Idea-stage fiction premise (silent emotional stories). Hook: Start with one familiar corner. Takeaway/theme: One familiar detail can be a starting point for a new space.
description: A traveler wants to unpack in a bare temporary room, but the oversized suitcase makes every object feel out of place. They find one small familiar drawing in a side pocket, tape it beside the bed, and gradually arrange the room around that single recognizable corner.
